Name: Gift Courier
Author: linono32569
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b][u]*Need SMAPI4.1.0+,Optional(可选)GMCM*[/u][/b]
A convenient gift notebook for Stardew Valley. Find gifts, check friendship levels, and send gifts remotely without searching through chests or finding NPCs.
一款方便实用的星露谷礼物手账。查询人物喜好、查看好感度、寻找库存礼物，还能随时随地远程送礼。

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the[/color]

[code]GiftCourier[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder into your[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load your save and press [b]D3 (number 3)[/b] to open the gift notebook.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]下载并解压，将[/color]

[code]GiftCourier[/code][color=#D4D4D8]文件夹放入游戏的[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]目录。进入存档后，按 [b]D3（主键盘数字 3）[/b] 打开礼物手账。 [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gift Finder:[/b] Browse NPC gift preferences.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Storage Search:[/b] Find gifts in your backpack and chests.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Remote Gifting:[/b] Send gifts without visiting NPCs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]One-Click Gifting:[/b] Automatically choose suitable gifts for selected NPCs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Friendship Display:[/b] View NPC hearts and friendship points.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gift Planning:[/b] Check which gifts you still need to prepare.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bilingual Support:[/b] English and Simplified Chinese.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]主要功能[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]礼物查询：[/b] 查看 NPC 的礼物喜好。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]库存搜索：[/b] 查找背包和箱子里的礼物。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]远程送礼：[/b] 不用寻找 NPC，随时随地赠送礼物。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]一键送礼：[/b] 为勾选的 NPC 自动选择最合适的礼物。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]好感度显示：[/b] 查看人物爱心等级与具体点数。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]礼物规划：[/b] 查看尚未准备的礼物。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]双语支持：[/b] 简体中文与英文。[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/*]
[/list]需要安装星露谷物语 1.6+SMAPI 及 GMCM。

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI and GMCM developers, and the Stardew Valley modding community!
感谢[/color]
